name: Eagle
tagline: I carried the first humans to the Moon, then served as their launch pad.
discovery: Thanks to me, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the Moon and brought back about 21.5 kg of lunar rocks and dust that scientists still study today.
status_note: I am still exactly where I landed, surrounded by the astronauts' footprints.

presentation.title: Hello, I'm Eagle.
presentation.body: I'm a descent stage from the Apollo 11 mission. I carried the first humans to the Moon, then served as their launch pad.

chapters.title: A spacecraft in two pieces
chapters.body: I am the bottom half of the lunar module Eagle: the descent stage. On 20 July 1969, I land in the Sea of Tranquility with two astronauts on board. A few hours later, Neil Armstrong climbs down my ladder and sets foot on the Moon.

chapters.title: A launch pad
chapters.body: To leave, the astronauts take only the top half of the module, the ascent stage. I stay on the ground and serve as a platform: the ascent stage lifts off from my back to rejoin the spacecraft waiting in orbit.

chapters.title: The message I carry
chapters.body: On one of my legs, a plaque reads: "Here men from the planet Earth first set foot upon the Moon, July 1969 A.D. We came in peace for all mankind."

quiz.question: Which part of the Apollo 11 lunar module stayed on the Moon?
quiz.explanation: The descent stage served as a launch pad: only the top half left.

quiz.question: In which region of the Moon did Eagle land?
quiz.explanation: A fairly flat, safe plain, chosen thanks to pictures from earlier robotic missions.
